positive_prompts.prompt: Audit our GG20 threshold ECDSA keygen and signing implementation. Each party generates a Paillier modulus and publishes range proofs for the MtA (multiplicative-to-additive) share conversion. I want the Paillier modulus validity proofs and the MtA/MtAwc range proofs checked for missing or unverified conditions.

Review a CGGMP21-style threshold ECDSA signing service that runs many concurrent signing sessions with presignatures. I am worried about session-state isolation across concurrent signings, resharing of key shares, and whether identifiable abort can be triggered without leaking share information.

negative_prompts.prompt: Audit our FROST threshold Schnorr signing implementation: distributed key generation with VSS share verification, nonce commitment binding across the two signing rounds, and Lagrange interpolation of partial signatures.

Review this Rust wallet code that signs Ethereum transactions with a single secp256k1 ECDSA key using the alloy signer API, including EIP-712 typed-data hashing before signing. No threshold or multi-party protocol is involved.
